[[Seborhin Protector Zuor]] is granted the honor of protecting the [[Garden of Seborhin]] from unauthorized access.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Forum Highlands}} (right outside Garden of Seborhin, very near [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]])

==Dialogue==
Before completion of [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]]:
:''"This gateway leads to the Majestic Garden of Seborhin. It is the most sacred and beautiful spot in all of Vabbi. Entrance is only granted to those traveling with royalty."''
:'''Please let me in. I am traveling with Princess [[Tahlkora]], daughter of [[Prince Mehtu the Wise|Mehtu the wise]].''' {{sic|Mehtu the Wise}} (Only if Tahlkora is in your [[party]])
::''"The garden is yours to enjoy. Please stay as long as you would like. Are you ready to enter?"''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the Garden of Seborhin)
::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''

While Garden of Seborhin is replaced by [[Nightfallen Garden]]; i.e. after completion of Grand Court of Sebelkeh and before completion of [[Abaddon's Gate]], or while [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]] is active:
:''"Has [[Lyssa]] forsaken us? How could she allow the corruption of this garden of purity!" {{sic|No question mark after "purity"}}
:;{{x}} I'll be on my way.

After completion of Abaddon's Gate and Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger is not active:
:''"Ah, <[[character]] name>, it is an honor to speak with one of the saviors of [[Elona]]. You have removed the darkness from this garden and for that I will be forever grateful. Would like {{sic|"like" shouldn't be there}} you like to take a stroll in the Majestic Garden of Seborhin?"''
:{{ask|gold}} '''Yes, I would like to spend some time enjoying the garden's beauty.'''
::''"The garden is yours to enjoy. Please stay as long as you would like. Are you ready to enter?"''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the Garden of Seborhin)
::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''
:;{{x}} I'll be on my way.

==Notes==
*While Garden of Seborhin is replaced by Nightfallen Garden, talking to Seborhin Protector Zuor is not required to enter Nightfallen Garden (i.e. your character can go through the Nightfallen Garden [[portal]]).
